claim: The demo turns a selected sample region into editable text.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; activate the shipped inventory region and assert useful rows appear

claim: Screen images stay on your computer, with no cloud image upload or app telemetry.
where: landing facts, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop-app webview; run bundled sample capture through real local OCR, pin it, and assert no cross-origin requests

claim: Recognised text can be spoken with the device voice.
where: landing workflow and demo Speak text button
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a speech synthesis spy; assert the recognised text reaches the device speech API

claim: Recognised text can be pinned and removed.
where: landing workflow and demo Pin result button
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; pin the sample result, assert its contents, then remove it

claim: Demo sample data is not saved.
where: first action and persistent demo banner
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; use and reset the demo, then assert no demo storage keys and no visible result

claim: App captures and pinned results stay in memory and are discarded when the capture window reloads or closes.
where: landing privacy boundary, privacy page, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop-app webview; run the real bundled OCR path, pin the result, assert capture state is absent from localStorage, reload, and assert capture and result are gone
native unit test asserts the shortcut registered by the runtime is exactly Control+Shift+Space

claim: Capture, OCR, speech, copy, and pin work without a license.
where: landing facts, paid tier, terms, and README
sandbox: fresh desktop-app webview with no license; run the real sample OCR path and assert speech, copy, and pin all work

claim: Install scripts verify the downloaded app against the published SHA256 checksum before installing.
sandbox: local fixture release; assert a matching Linux artifact installs and a tampered artifact is rejected without creating the command link

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for the service worker, set the context offline, reload, and assert the demo heading

claim: English OCR files ship with the app.
sandbox: fresh browser context; fetch the same-origin English language model and OCR worker and assert both contain data

claim: A valid supporter license activates two blueprint page themes.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded valid license response; select the second theme and assert its palette is applied

claim: A $19 one-time supporter license is available through Sociobot checkout.
where: landing facts, paid tier, and README
sandbox: live public product catalog must list USD 19.00, then checkout must return HTTP 303 to an HTTPS checkout.dodopayments.com session
